posts.title: How this blog works
posts.summary: A quick note on how to add, edit, and remove posts from the Blog Posts section of the dashboard — delete this post once you're comfortable.
posts.body:
Open **/admin**, go to *Blog Posts*, and click *All Posts*.

Each post is one item in a list: a title, a date, a short summary (shown on the blog listing page), and a body (shown on the full post page — this box supports headings, bold text, links, and paragraphs).

The most recent post should sit at the top of the list. Add a new one with the **Add** button, or delete this example once you've got the hang of it.

## A note on slugs

The *slug* field controls the post's web address, e.g. a slug of `pricing-a-brand-deal` becomes `yoursite.com/post.html?slug=pricing-a-brand-deal`. Keep it short, lowercase, and use hyphens instead of spaces.
